name: cv
title: CV / Résumé
description: Publishes a CV/résumé page from Markdown, with as many variants as you like — one is live at a time, chosen in this plugin's settings.
note: Each variant is one Markdown file in content/cv/ — edit them under "CV" in the sidebar. Set activeVariant to the filename (without .md) of the one that should be live; leave it empty when you only have one.
